def load_font\(size\):
    for name in ["arialbd.ttf", "arial.ttf", "DejaVuSans-Bold.ttf", "DejaVuSans.ttf"]:
        try:
            return ImageFont.truetype\(name, size\)
        except:
            pass
    return ImageFont.load_default\(\)

def draw_popup\(draw, img, px, py, pw, ph\):
    """Disegna il popup CVFit in posizione \(px,py\) con dimensioni \(pw,ph\)"""
    # Ombra
    for s in range\(20, 0, -1\):
        alpha = int\(180 * \(1 - s/20\)\)
        shadow = Image.new\("RGBA", img.size, \(0,0,0,0\)\)
        sd = ImageDraw.Draw\(shadow\)
        sd.rounded_rectangle\([px+s, py+s, px+pw+s, py+ph+s], radius=12, fill=\(0,0,0,alpha\)\)
        img.paste\(shadow, mask=shadow\)
    draw = ImageDraw.Draw\(img\)
    # Body popup
    draw.rounded_rectangle\([px, py, px+pw, py+ph], radius=12, fill=SURFACE, outline=BORDER, width=1\)
    return draw

def draw_header\(draw, px, py, pw\):
    # Header bar
    draw.rounded_rectangle\([px, py, px+pw, py+48], radius=12, fill=SURFACE\)
    draw.rectangle\([px, py+24, px+pw, py+48], fill=SURFACE\)
    draw.line\([px, py+48, px+pw, py+48], fill=BORDER, width=1\)
    # Logo
    f_icon = load_font\(22\)
    f_logo = load_font\(18\)
    draw.text\(\(px+16, py+14\), "⚡", font=f_icon, fill=\(255,220,50\)\)
    draw.text\(\(px+40, py+16\), "CVFit", font=f_logo, fill=ACCENT\)

def rounded_rect_gradient\(draw, x1, y1, x2, y2, r, c1, c2\):
    draw.rounded_rectangle\([x1, y1, x2, y2], radius=r, fill=c1\)
